name: light-launcher
description: Ultra-lightweight, customizable Linux gaming launcher powered by Go & Svelte

scripts.build: bun run build:launcher && bun run build:instance
scripts.build:instance: mkdir -p bin && go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o bin/light-launcher-instance$(go env GOEXE) ./core/cmd/instance
scripts.build:launcher:dev: mkdir -p bin && go build -o bin/light-launcher$(go env GOEXE) ./core/cmd/launcher
scripts.build:linux: bun run build && bun run build:shell:gtk
scripts.build:shell:gtk: mkdir -p bin && cd shell/gtk && go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../../bin/light-launcher-shell .
scripts.build:shell:webview2: mkdir -p bin && cd shell/webview2 && go build -ldflags="-s -w -H=windowsgui" -o ../../bin/light-launcher-shell.exe .
scripts.dev:linux: bun run build:launcher:dev && bun run build:instance && bun run build:shell:gtk && concurrently -k "bun run dev:renderer" "./bin/light-launcher --dev-token dev --port 9246 --ui src/renderer"
scripts.dev:windows: bun run build:launcher:dev && bun run build:instance && bun run build:shell:webview2 && concurrently -k "bun run dev:renderer" "./bin/light-launcher.exe --dev-token dev --port 9246 --ui src/renderer"
scripts.lint: bun run lint:ui && bun run lint:go
scripts.test: bun run test:ui && bun run test:go
